skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of destination management including concepts, importance, and characteristics of tourist destinations and destination management organizations (DMOs).

Develop basic knowledge on analyzing and formulating strategic plans for tourist destinations, including macro-environment analysis, competitive analysis, vision setting, goal formulation, and development solutions.
Gain knowledge related to positioning and branding of tourist destinations, market segmentation, target market selection, and marketing mix strategies.
Learn about content and methods of managing customer experience quality at tourist destinations, current trends in destination management.
Develop skills in analyzing destination components, business environment, sustainability of tourist destinations, and using marketing tools.
